:::{#def-pairwise-disjoint}
#### Pairwise disjoint sets, mutually disjoint sets

Some [sets](#def-set) $A_1, A_2, \ldots$ (a list that may end or go on without end)
are **pairwise disjoint**
[@wikipedia_disjoint_sets]
(also called **mutually disjoint**)
when every two of them are [disjoint](#def-disjoint-sets):

$$A_i \cap A_j = \emptyset \quad \text{for all } i \neq j$$

:::
